groups.contract: Grass cull dispatch, transformed bounds and atomic output require actual host capacity contract
groups.disposition: Complete37-line exact shader personally read. Reset guards indirect array length; main foldsid.x+id.y*65535*64 then checks source length, sentinel batch or batch>=indirect length rejected. Instance_uniforms/batch_offsets lengths must be coherent with indirect count, output start+atomic offset must fit storage allocation, and source index folding/products must be representable. This adds actual shader-side support for supplied ROOT-INITIAL04-F053 dispatch-grid precision at audit/continuation/root/initial04-invariant-operations/findings.jsonl#53; no ordinary huge GPU allocation or execution claimed. Frobenius norm upper-bounds actual linear transform for valid finite matrices and max1 preserves world-space displacement when shrinking, but dot/sum/radius products can overflow before finite computed admission. Actual CPU bounds/displacement/scale/capacity supplier remains required; do not promote rawshader arithmetic alone as new ordinary defect or claim ownership from archived GPU grants.

groups.contract: Foliage and instanced grass deformation retain computed direction and mesh aggregate prerequisites
groups.disposition: Both complete exact shader bodies personally read, no compiled/device/visual execution. Mesh UV/UV_B/color encode root, curve row, blade threshold and seed-head applicability; legacy seed-head branch uses negativeV and rigid rotate_between, instanced path reconstructs ribbon independently. Local/global source transform, raw wind direction, scene normals, side vector and tangent feed many normalize operations. Adding1e-4 to a vector is an ordinary fallback heuristic, not proof of nonzero for every signed input (it can exactly cancel); smoothstep interaction radius also needs actual ordered positive producer bounds. Zero wind vector/nonfinite/degenerate transforms are pending actual first-party producer/caller witnesses, not promoted current gameplay defects. rotate_between clamps cosine and floors1+cos.001, an explicit antiparallel approximation policy, not a universal exact rotation guarantee. Full four-frame/body/curve output needs canonical numerical readmission at actual preparation port; no arbitrary global wind or position caps.

groups.contract: Coverage, LOD and lighting arithmetic preserve distinct actual renderer policies
groups.disposition: Legacy near/far uniform quality branch and ground-mask bypass rely on host-proven TallGrass interior patch, while instanced path consumes packed low-byte coverage /255 and CPU placement mask sampling. Current shaders differ in blade lean/width reconstruction and inflorescence support; equivalence/current mesh producer eligibility cannot be inferred solely from comments and remains exact aggregate ownership dependency. Instanced fragment uses complementary signed16-step dither partitions with common pixel hash, whereas legacy alpha coverage is a separate intentional path. Signed dither MIN abs semantics is not a current endpoint case without nativeproducer outside represented16step range. Directional light loop trusts native bounded light count, exposure/material/color inputs native GPU ports. Preserve two-sided upper-hemisphere normals, target rendering policy and no unverified art acceptance; no shader checks, renderer startup, textures regenerated or benchmark run.
